versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart E — Power-Plant Installations; Reciprocating Engines
versions.text: Oil tanks shall be provided with an expansion space of not less than 10 perceut of the tank capacity or Y gallon, whichever is greater. It shall not be possible inadvertently to fill the oil tank expansion space when the airplane is in the normal ground attitude.
